name: Alertness
effects: Not much gets by this hero. He's very observant and perceptive, and adds +2 to his Notice rolls to hear, see, or otherwise sense the world around him.

name: Ambidextrous
effects: Your warrior is as deft with his left hand as he is with his right. He ignores the Off-Hand penalty and may stack Parry bonuses from both weapons when dual-wielding.

name: Arcane Background
effects: Grants access to supernatural abilities through exposure to strange energies, studies, or divine gifts. See Chapter Five for details on using Arcane Backgrounds.

name: Arcane Resistance
effects: Reduces the effect of arcane attacks by causing arcane skills to suffer a −2 penalty and reducing magical damage by 2.

name: Improved Arcane Resistance
effects: Further enhances resistance to arcane attacks, increasing penalties to −4 for skills and damage.

name: Aristocrat
effects: This individual walks in elite social circles. Adds +2 to Persuasion when Networking with elites and +2 to Common Knowledge rolls about upper-class etiquette, heraldry, and gossip.

name: Attractive
effects: Adds +1 to Performance and Persuasion rolls if the target is attracted to the character's type.

name: Very Attractive
effects: Increases the bonus from the Attractive Edge to +2.

name: Berserk
effects: Allows the character to go berserk after taking a Wound or Shaken result, increasing Strength and Toughness but requiring Wild Attacks and adding risks.

name: Brave
effects: Adds +2 to Fear checks and subtracts 2 from Fear Table results.

name: Brawny
effects: Increases Size and Toughness by 1, and treats Strength as one die type higher for Encumbrance and Minimum Strength requirements.

name: Brute
effects: Links Athletics to Strength for Advancement, allows resisting Athletics Tests with Strength, and extends the range of thrown items.

name: Charismatic
effects: Grants a free reroll on Persuasion rolls.

name: Elan
effects: Adds +2 to rerolls on Trait rolls when spending a Benny.

name: Fame
effects: Makes the character a minor celebrity, doubling performance pay and adding +1 to Persuasion rolls with friendly individuals who recognize her.

name: Famous
effects: The character becomes widely known, increasing earnings and Persuasion bonuses but attracting more attention and obligations.

name: Fast Healer
effects: Adds +2 to Vigor rolls for natural healing and reduces the healing check interval to three days.

name: Fleet-Footed
effects: Increases Pace by +2 and upgrades the running die by one step.

name: Linguist
effects: Grants knowledge of half the Smarts die type in Language skills at d6.

name: Luck
effects: Grants one extra Benny at the start of each session.

name: Great Luck
effects: Increases the Bennies granted by Luck to two.

name: Quick
effects: Allows the character to discard Action Cards of Five or lower and draw again until receiving a higher card.

name: Rich
effects: Starts with three times the normal starting funds and an annual income equivalent to $150,000 if appropriate.

name: Filthy Rich
effects: Starts with five times the normal starting funds and an annual income equivalent to $500,000 if appropriate.

name: Block
effects: The hero's Parry increases by +1, and any Gang Up bonus against him is reduced by one.

name: Improved Block
effects: The hero's Parry bonus is now +2, and the Gang Up bonus against him is reduced by 2.

name: Brawler
effects: Brawlers increase their Toughness by 1 and roll Strength +d4 when hitting with their fists or feet (or claws if they have them). If they already have a damage die from other sources, increase the damage die type by one.

name: Bruiser
effects: The fighter increases his Toughness by an additional +1, and the damage caused with his fists or claws increases another die type.

name: Calculating
effects: When the hero's Action Card is a Five or less, he ignores up to 2 points of penalties on one action that turn, including Multi-Action, cover, Range, or Wound penalties.

name: Combat Reflexes
effects: The hero adds +2 to rolls when attempting to recover from being Shaken or Stunned.

name: Counterattack
effects: Once per round, if not Shaken or Stunned, the character receives a Free Attack against one failed Fighting attack against him.

name: Improved Counterattack
effects: The hero gets a Free Attack against up to three failed attacks each round.

name: Dead Shot
effects: When the hero's Action Card is a Joker, double the total damage of the first successful Athletics or Shooting roll that round.

name: Dodge
effects: Subtracts 2 from all ranged attacks made against the character unless the victim of a surprise attack.

name: Improved Dodge
effects: The hero adds +2 when Evading area effect attacks.

name: Double Tap
effects: Adds +1 to hit and damage when firing two shots in rapid succession, expending an extra bullet. Provides higher bonuses for weapons with Three Round Burst.

name: Extraction
effects: When withdrawing from melee, one adjacent attacker (player's choice) does not get a free Fighting attack.

name: Improved Extraction
effects: Up to three foes (player's choice) don't get attacks when the hero moves out of melee with them.

name: Feint
effects: When performing a Test with the Fighting skill, the hero can make the foe resist with Smarts instead of Agility.

name: First Strike
effects: Once per round, the hero gets a free Fighting attack against a foe immediately after they move into Reach.

name: Improved First Strike
effects: The hero may attack up to three foes each turn as they move into Reach.

name: Free Runner
effects: The hero moves at full Pace on Difficult Ground when on foot and adds +2 to Athletics rolls for climbing and in foot Chases.

name: Frenzy
effects: Rolls a second Fighting die with one of the hero's Fighting attacks for the turn, which may be allocated to the same or a different target.

name: Improved Frenzy
effects: The fighter rolls an extra Fighting die with up to two Fighting attacks in the same turn.

name: Giant Killer
effects: The hero adds +1d6 damage when attacking creatures who are three or more Sizes larger than himself. For example, a human (Size 0) gains the bonus against creatures of Size 3 or greater.

name: Hard To Kill
effects: The hero ignores Wound penalties when making Vigor rolls to avoid Bleeding Out.

name: Harder to Kill
effects: If the hero is 'killed,' roll a die. On an odd result, they are dead. On an even result, they are Incapacitated but escape death, potentially being captured or left for dead instead.

name: Improvisational Fighter
effects: The hero ignores the usual −2 penalty when wielding improvised weapons.

name: Iron Jaw
effects: The hero adds +2 to Soak rolls and Vigor rolls to avoid Knockout Blows.

name: Killer Instinct
effects: The hero gets a free reroll in any opposed Test they initiate.

name: Level Headed
effects: The hero draws an additional Action Card in combat and chooses which to use.

name: Improved Level Headed
effects: The hero draws two additional Action Cards in combat and chooses which to keep.

name: Marksman
effects: The hero adds +1 to an Athletics (throwing) or Shooting roll, or ignores up to 2 points of penalties, if she doesn't move and fires a weapon with a Rate of Fire of 1 as her first action.

name: Martial Artist
effects: The hero's fists and feet become weapons, causing Strength+d4 damage and adding +1 to attacks. This does not apply to other natural weapons.

name: Martial Warrior
effects: The hero's Fighting bonus increases to +2 and her damage die steps up one additional level.

name: Mighty Blow
effects: If the hero's Action Card is a Joker, the damage of their first successful Fighting attack that round is doubled.

name: Nerves of Steel
effects: The hero ignores 1 point of Wound penalties.

name: Improved Nerves of Steel
effects: The hero ignores 2 points of Wound penalties.

name: No Mercy
effects: When spending a Benny to reroll damage, the hero adds +2 to the final total.

name: Rapid Fire
effects: The hero may increase their weapon's Rate of Fire by 1 for one of their Shooting attacks during the turn.

name: Improved Rapid Fire
effects: The hero may increase their weapon's Rate of Fire by 1 twice in the same turn, using a Multi-Action.

name: Rock and Roll!
effects: If the hero doesn't move, they ignore the Recoil penalty when firing at a Rate of Fire of 2 or higher.

name: Steady Hands
effects: The hero ignores the Unstable Platform penalty and reduces the running penalty to -1.

name: Sweep
effects: The hero makes a single Fighting attack against all targets in Reach with a -2 penalty. Damage is resolved separately.

name: Improved Sweep
effects: The hero ignores the -2 penalty when making a Sweep attack.

name: Trademark Weapon
effects: The hero gains +1 to attack rolls and Parry when using their chosen weapon. This bonus applies only after a few days if the weapon is replaced.

name: Improved Trademark Weapon
effects: The bonuses for the hero's chosen weapon increase to +2.

name: Two-Fisted
effects: The hero avoids Multi-Action penalties when making Fighting attacks with each hand on separate actions. Off-Hand penalties still apply unless Ambidextrous.

name: Two-Gun Kid
effects: The hero avoids Multi-Action penalties when using ranged weapons in each hand on separate actions. Can combine with Two-Fisted for melee and ranged attacks.

name: Command
effects: Extras in Command Range add +1 to Spirit rolls when attempting to recover from being Shaken and to Vigor rolls when recovering from being Stunned.

name: Command Presence
effects: The hero's Command Range increases to 10" (20 yards).

name: Fervor
effects: Extras in Command Range add +1 to their Fighting damage rolls.

name: Hold the Line!
effects: Extras in Command Range add +1 to their Toughness.

name: Inspire
effects: Once per turn, the hero may roll their Battle skill to Support a type of Trait roll for all allied Extras in Command Range. Requires communication.

name: Natural Leader
effects: Leadership Edges that apply only to Extras now also apply to Wild Cards.

name: Tactician
effects: The hero is dealt an extra Action Card each round and may give it to any allied Extra in Command Range.

name: Master Tactician
effects: The hero is dealt two extra Action Cards each round to distribute to allies.

name: Artificer
effects: Allows the creation of Arcane Devices that can be given to allies.

name: Channeling
effects: Reduces Power Point cost by 1 (to a minimum of 0) when getting a raise on an arcane skill roll or activating an arcane device.

name: Concentration
effects: Doubles the base Duration of any non-Instant power, including maintained powers.

name: Extra Effort
effects: Spend 1 Power Point to add +1 to a Focus total or 3 Power Points to add +2. Cannot improve a Critical Failure.

name: Gadgeteer
effects: Allows the hero to create jury-rigged devices that activate powers available to Weird Scientists of their Rank or lower.

name: Holy/Unholy Warrior
effects: Adds +1 to the total of a final Soak roll for each Power Point spent, up to a maximum of +4.

name: Mentalist
effects: Adds +2 to opposed Psionics rolls, whether using powers against a foe or defending against a rival.

name: New Powers
effects: An arcane character may learn two new powers by choosing this Edge (which may be taken multiple times). He may choose from any powers of his Rank or lower normally available to his particular Arcane Background. A character can add a new Trapping on a power she already has instead of gaining a new one.

name: Power Points
effects: This Edge grants an additional 5 Power Points. Power Points may be selected more than once, but only once per Rank. It may be taken as often as desired at Legendary Rank, but each grants only 2 additional points.

name: Power Surge
effects: The character recovers 10 Power Points when his Action Card is a Joker. This may not exceed his usual limit.

name: Rapid Recharge
effects: Increases Power Points recharge rate to 10 every hour.

name: Improved Rapid Recharge
effects: Increases Power Points recharge rate to 20 every hour.

name: Soul Drain
effects: Allows a character to take Fatigue to recover Power Points. Fatigue levels cannot incapacitate the character and recover only naturally.

name: Wizard
effects: Allows a Wizard to spend 1 extra Power Point to change a spell's Trapping, which can have significant consequences if a foe has resistance or weakness to the spell's usual Trapping.

name: Ace
effects: Aces ignore two points of penalties to any Boating, Driving, or Piloting roll, and may spend Bennies to Soak damage for any vehicle they control or command.

name: Acrobat
effects: Acrobats get one free reroll on Athletics totals involving balance, tumbling, or grappling.

name: Combat Acrobat
effects: Attacks against a Combat Acrobat suffer a −1 penalty if the character is aware of the attack, can reasonably move, and isn't suffering Encumbrance or Minimum Strength penalties.

name: Assassin
effects: Assassins add +2 to damage rolls when their foe is Vulnerable or they have The Drop.

name: Investigator
effects: Investigators add +2 to Research rolls and Notice rolls made to search through clutter or spy hidden items.

name: Jack-Of-All-Trades
effects: Allows the character to make a Smarts roll to temporarily gain a skill, lasting until a different subject is studied.

name: McGyver
effects: Allows the character to craft improvised devices using a Repair roll, such as explosives, weapons, or tools.

name: Mr. Fix It
effects: Adds +2 to Repair rolls and halves the time required to fix something with a raise.

name: Scholar
effects: Adds +2 to a chosen Smarts-based skill. May be taken multiple times for different skills.

name: Soldier
effects: Professional soldiers get used to carrying heavy loads and enduring harsh conditions. After a few days getting used to their gear (GM's call), they treat their Strength as one die type higher when determining Encumbrance and Minimum Strength to use armor, weapons, and equipment without a penalty. This stacks with the Brawny Edge. They also get a free reroll on Vigor rolls made to survive environmental hazards.

name: Thief
effects: Thieves specialize in deceit, treachery, and acrobatics. They add +1 to Athletics rolls made to climb in urban areas, +1 to Stealth rolls in urban environments, and +1 to Thievery rolls in all circumstances.

name: Woodsman
effects: Woodsmen are rangers, scouts, and hunters. They add +2 to Survival rolls and Stealth rolls made in the wild.

name: Bolster
effects: When this character successfully Tests a foe, he may also remove the Distracted or Vulnerable state from one of his allies.

name: Common Bond
effects: A character with this Edge may freely give her Bennies to any other character she can communicate with.

name: Connections
effects: Your heroine is connected to people or organizations who can help her when the chips are down. She can call on her friends for a favor once per session.

name: Humiliate
effects: Your hero gets a free reroll on Taunt Tests.

name: Menacing
effects: The goon adds +2 to her Intimidation rolls.

name: Provoke
effects: Once per turn, when your hero uses Taunt for a Test and gets a raise, the enemy suffers a −2 penalty to affect any other target besides the one who provoked her.

name: Rabble-Rouser
effects: Once per turn, a character with this Edge can make a social Test with Intimidation or Taunt against all enemies in a Medium Blast Template. Each defender resists and is affected separately.

name: Reliable
effects: He gets a free reroll on any Support roll.

name: Retort
effects: If a character with Retort gets a raise when resisting an Intimidation or Taunt Test, the foe is Distracted.

name: Streetwise
effects: Streetwise characters add +2 to Intimidation or Persuasion rolls made to Network with shady or criminal elements and add +2 to Common Knowledge rolls related to disreputable activities.

name: Strong Willed
effects: He adds +2 to his total when resisting Tests with Smarts or Spirit.

name: Iron Will
effects: The hero now adds his Strong Willed bonus to resist powers and negate their effects. Iron Will doesn't stack with Brave.

name: Work the Room
effects: Once per turn, you can roll an additional skill die when Supporting with Persuasion or Performance. The additional die Supports any other ally who can see or hear your hero.

name: Work the Crowd
effects: As Work the Room but the hero now can Support another on up to two of her Support actions.

name: Beast Bond
effects: These characters may spend their own Bennies for any animals under their control, including mounts, pets, familiars, and so on.

name: Beast Master
effects: Animals take to your hero quickly and easily, and he gains a loyal animal companion. Beast Master may be taken more than once to gain additional benefits such as stronger pets or additional companions.

name: Champion
effects: Champions add +2 damage when attacking supernaturally evil (or good, if they're evil) creatures. This applies to all forms of damage, including area effects and powers.

name: Chi
effects: At the start of each combat encounter, the hero gains a Chi Point that can be spent to reroll failed attacks, force an enemy to reroll an attack, or add +d6 damage to a successful Fighting attack.

name: Danger Sense
effects: Adds +2 to Notice rolls for Surprise. In other situations, allows a Notice roll at −2 to detect hazards.

name: Healer
effects: Adds +2 to all Healing rolls, whether natural or magical.

name: Liquid Courage
effects: After consuming alcohol, Vigor increases one die type, and one level of Wound penalties can be ignored. However, Smarts, Agility, and linked skills suffer a −1 penalty. Effect lasts for one hour.

name: Scavenger
effects: Once per encounter, the hero may find or recall a needed piece of equipment or resource.

name: Followers
effects: Grants five followers who fight by the hero's side. Use Soldier profiles for followers.

name: Professional
effects: Increases the chosen Trait and its limit by one step.

name: Expert
effects: Increases the chosen Trait and its limit by an additional step.

name: Master
effects: The Wild Die for the selected Trait increases to d10.

name: Sidekick
effects: Grants a Novice Rank sidekick who is a Wild Card and advances alongside the hero.

name: Tough As Nails
effects: Allows the character to take four Wounds before being Incapacitated.

name: Tougher Than Nails
effects: Allows the character to take five Wounds before being Incapacitated.

name: Weapon Master
effects: Increases Parry by +1, and the bonus damage die for Fighting rolls becomes a d8.

name: Master of Arms
effects: Increases Parry by an additional +1, and the Fighting bonus damage die becomes a d10.
